main_text.l: efficere posse, quin institutus sit, quip-
pe qui suus aliquo tempore fuit: sed ta-
men sua sponte aditurum iccirco, quia
mortis tempore in familia non erat.
Pactum de forte per partes soluen-
ni fortis & usurarum, ita per uniuersam
psi, me accepisse à Publio Mę-uio

page.notes: The running head is decorated and could not be read. The line ending "præ torio" may carry a printed hyphen; I have written it as "præ-torio" but the scan does not show it clearly. "Questionū" is read with a plain s; the scan may show a ligature here. The bottom ornament (a small bullet) is printer's decoration and was left out.
